# Bad Control Flow Examples
# Demonstrates CK3510-CK3521 - Control flow validation errors

# ERROR: CK3103
# ERROR: CK3314
# ERROR: COND-001
# ERROR: COND-003
# ERROR: EVENT-012
namespace = events_bad_control

# ERROR CK3510: trigger_else without trigger_if
events_bad_control.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0001.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0001.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# ERROR CK3510: trigger_else without preceding trigger_if
		trigger_else = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0001.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# ERROR CK3511: Multiple trigger_else blocks
events_bad_control.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0002.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0002.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 100
			}
			add_prestige = 100
		}

		trigger_else = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}

		# ERROR CK3511: Only one trigger_else allowed per trigger_if
		trigger_else = {
			add_piety = 25
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0002.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# trigger_if missing limit
events_bad_control.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0003.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0003.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
# trigger_if requires limit block
		trigger_if = {
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0003.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Empty trigger_if limit
events_bad_control.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0004.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0004.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		trigger_if = {
# Empty limit block
			limit = {
			}
			add_gold = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0004.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# CK3514: on_trigger_fail defined (INFO - not an error, just informational)
events_bad_control.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0005.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0005.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# CK3514: Custom failure handler present (informational)
		on_trigger_fail = {
			add_piety = 25
		}

		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 100
			}
			add_gold = -100
			add_prestige = 100
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0005.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# Duplicate trigger conditions
events_bad_control.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0006.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0006.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
# Same condition checked twice
		is_adult = yes
		is_ruler = yes
		is_adult = yes # Duplicate!
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0006.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# after block in hidden event
events_bad_control.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		add_gold = 100
	}

# after block ignored in hidden events
	after = {
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# after block without options
events_bad_control.0008 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		add_gold = 100
	}

# after runs after player choice, but there are no options
	after = {
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# Multiple control flow errors
events_bad_control.0009 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0009.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0009.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
# Duplicate
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		# ERROR CK3510: trigger_else without trigger_if
		trigger_else = {
			add_gold = 50
		}

		trigger_if = {
# Missing limit
			add_prestige = 100
		}

		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 100
			}
			add_gold = -100
		}

		# ERROR CK3511: Multiple trigger_else blocks
		trigger_else = {
			add_piety = 25
		}

		trigger_else = {
			add_piety = 10
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0009.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
}

# + CK3513: trigger_if variations
events_bad_control.0010 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0010.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0010.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
# No limit block at all
		trigger_if = {
			add_gold = 100
		}

# Empty limit
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
			}
			add_prestige = 50
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0010.a
		add_piety = 25
	}
}

# + CK3521: after block issues
events_bad_control.0011 = {
	type = character_event
	hidden = yes # ERROR CK3520: Hidden event with after

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		add_gold = 100
	}

# Ignored in hidden event
# No options to trigger after
	after = {
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3510: Standalone trigger_else
events_bad_control.0012 = {
	type = character_event
	title = events_bad_control.0012.t
	desc = events_bad_control.0012.desc

	left_portrait = root

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		add_gold = 100

		# ERROR CK3510: trigger_else with no matching trigger_if
		trigger_else = {
			add_prestige = 50
		}

		# This trigger_if comes AFTER trigger_else, so it doesn't match
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 200
			}
			add_piety = 25
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = events_bad_control.0012.a
		add_gold = 50
	}
}
